paragraphs: HydroApps sells cloud software for running aquatic facilities, pulling safety, compliance and staff management into one place. It is pitched at operators still juggling spreadsheets, binders and paperwork.

The product is split into digital modules, each covering a core part of operations. Staff log incidents as time-stamped, audit-ready reports. Water testing calculates LSI automatically and flags readings that fall out of range. The staff module sends alerts for upcoming certification expirations. Scheduling covers shift swaps and fill-ins. Built-in forms are aligned with the MAHC for compliance.

The platform is cloud-based and mobile-friendly, so records can be reached away from the pool deck. The company says over 20,000 people use HydroApps. One published client conversation describes a team replacing paper documentation with connected digital workflows.
